title: ProCTI: Prototype-Refined Global Conditioning for Diffusion-Based Time Series Imputation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37632v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time series imputation has progressed from statistical and deep learning approaches to diffusion-based models, which have shown strong recent performance. Existing diffusion-based methods typically condition the reverse process using local contextual information from the current or neighbouring windows. Meanwhile, global dataset-level structure often remains implicit, limiting performance when local observations are sparse, noisy, or unrepresentative. To address this issue, we propose ProCTI, a diffusion-imputation framework that augments local conditioning with retrieved global dataset-level priors through learned prototypes. A hybrid conditioning mechanism integrates this global context with local signals during reverse diffusion, enabling more accurate reconstruction under varying missingness scenarios. translated_title: ProCTI：基于原型精炼全局条件化的扩散模型时间序列插补
translated_abstract: 时间序列插补已从统计方法和深度学习方法发展到基于扩散的模型，后者近年来展现出强大的性能。现有的基于扩散的方法通常利用来自当前或相邻窗口的局部上下文信息来条件化反向扩散过程。与此同时，数据集层面的全局结构往往保持隐式状态，这在局部观测稀疏、含噪或不具代表性时会限制插补性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ProCTI，这是一个扩散插补框架，通过学习到的原型来检索全局数据集级先验，从而增强局部条件化。一种混合条件化机制在反向扩散过程中将全局上下文与局部信号相融合，使得在各种缺失场景下都能实现更准确的重建。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，ProCTI在随机缺失情况下总体上优于强大的基线方法（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: ProCTI提出了一种扩散模型时间序列插补框架，通过学习到的原型检索全局数据集级先验，并将其与局部上下文信号进行混合条件化，从而在各种缺失场景下显著提升了插补重建的准确性。
en_tdlr: ProCTI is a diffusion-based time series imputation framework that augments local conditioning with retrieved global dataset-level priors via learned prototypes, achieving more accurate reconstruction under varying missingness scenarios.
